notes: Full available template text is included, not each personalized delivered MIME copy.
Notification engagement uses retained history snapshots; all-time notification report totals are unavailable.
Sequence send denominators repeat people across steps; they are not unique subscribers.
Capture times vary across contacts; historical addresses, missing recipients and exact missing seconds were not reconstructed.
Some source family and language labels are heuristic proxies rather than semantic ground truth.
Personal/session query parameters and unsubscribe destinations are sanitized in this web dataset; the original local archive is unchanged.
